meta.description: Registry for bounded multi-branch delta composition and admissibility-sensitive recursive operator chaining in Phase 3.

multi_branch_composition_entries.name: Delta Multi-Branch Composition
multi_branch_composition_entries.purpose: Represent bounded multi-branch delta composition and admissibility-sensitive recursive operator chaining across continuation systems.

multi_branch_composition_conditions.name: multi_branch_delta_composition_remains_defined
multi_branch_composition_conditions.description: Formal support for composing multi-valued delta proposals with projection and transport operators.

multi_branch_composition_conditions.name: recursive_operator_chaining_remains_admissible
multi_branch_composition_conditions.description: Each link in the recursive operator chain must satisfy current process admissibility windows.

multi_branch_composition_conditions.name: continuation_selection_under_composition_remains_detectable
multi_branch_composition_conditions.description: The system must maintain metrics for identifying how selection rules operate on composite operator outputs.

multi_branch_composition_conditions.name: multi_branch_composition_does_not_force_global_uniqueness
multi_branch_composition_conditions.description: Combining operators over multiple branches does not imply the existence of a unique global continuation path.

multi_branch_composition_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_composition_bias_remains_bounded
multi_branch_composition_conditions.description: The influence of frame orientation on composite operator behavior must stay within stable limits.

multi_branch_composition_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_composition_witness
multi_branch_composition_conditions.description: Pruning within a multi-branch composition sequence must not eliminate all possible continuation paths.

multi_branch_composition_conditions.name: recursive_composition_fragmentation_remains_classifiable
multi_branch_composition_conditions.description: Breakdown in composition stability at long horizons must map to registered transition or instability classes.

multi_branch_composition_conditions.name: composition_instability_remains_detectable
multi_branch_composition_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register the breakdown of multi-branch composition closure.
